previews.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square catalog preview illustration for a selectable Forbidden Memories themed duel field. Reference is the original low-poly board; keep its recognizable rectangular SPLIT stepped Egyptian game-table silhouette. Create a premium clean 3/4 isometric product-style illustration of a modern version: two opposing golden limestone checkerboard halves, dark recessed central seam, low engraved central Eye of Horus motif across the middle, several downward widening sandstone steps forming the perimeter plinth, deep emerald green glazed side friezes with gold feather and eye ornament, finely beveled gold borders, subtle stone grain and restrained metallic highlights. Same simple table mass as reference; no towers or pillars, no characters, no cards, no text or logo. Fully isolated against a dark navy studio background, centered object with clear margins, readable as a compact item icon. High quality painted 3D-style raster preview, not an actual screenshot or a 3D model file. Warm gold key light with cool edge separation; authentic modern Egyptian collectible aesthetic.
